data.body:
RESOLVED ELSEWHERE - closing as duplicate of 1dfd-063e-f341-48da.

The fix LANDED ON MAIN as commit 31844d5f9fb ("1dfd: fix PYSEC-2026-2132 via click override") from a parallel session, not via my change 1239. I verified this before acting rather than taking it on report:
* `git merge-base --is-ancestor 31844d5f9fb origin/main` -> 31844d5f9fb IS an ancestor of origin/main.
* `git show origin/main:pyproject.toml` -> `override-dependencies = ["click>=8.3.3"]` at ~line 270.
* `git show origin/main:uv.lock` -> `overrides = [{ name = "click", specifier = ">=8.3.3" }]` at line 51, and click resolving to version 8.4.2.
* Landed diff scope: pyproject.toml +9, uv.lock +11/-4 - the same two files and the same lock delta my change carried.

So main now implements EXACTLY the remediation analysed on this ticket. The gating pip-audit failure that blocked every patchset is fixed on main.

MY CHANGE 1239 IS ABANDONED. It had reached LLM-Review +1 and Verified +1, and its own pip-audit job passed - which was the independent proof that the override approach works before anything landed. Submitting it after 31844d5f9fb would have been a no-op re-application, so it was abandoned with a message pointing at 31844d5f9fb rather than left submittable for someone to land by accident.

THE ANALYSIS ON THIS TICKET REMAINS THE AUTHORITATIVE RECORD of why the fix has the shape it does, independent of which change carried it:
1. The cap comes from inspect-ai (via the [eval] extra) requiring `click!=8.2.0,<8.2.2,>=8.1.3`, and uv resolves extras jointly - so 8.2.1 really was the newest satisfying click. Proven by deleting inspect-ai and watching click jump to 8.4.2.
2. It is present in EVERY inspect-ai release through the latest 0.3.251, so waiting for upstream was not an option. Upstream PR UKGovernmentBEIS/inspect_ai#4596 (issue #4594) is open to relax it.
3. `uv lock --upgrade-package click` was a no-op because it only permits movement inside the existing constraint set - not a resolver-version problem.
4. `constraint-dependencies` CANNOT lift the cap - it only narrows an existing set, so its UNSATISFIABLE result does NOT show the lock bump is impossible. `override-dependencies` is the correct instrument because it REPLACES the requirement. This distinction is the crux: an earlier conclusion that option 1 was impossible rested on the wrong instrument.
5. The cap is stale, not a real incompatibility: inspect-ai 0.3.251 imports and runs its CLI (`inspect --help`, `inspect eval --help`, both exit 0) under click 8.4.2.
6. The resulting revision-2 lock passes `uv lock --check` under BOTH uv 0.7.18 and uv 0.12.1, `uv sync --locked --extra dev` resolves, and `pip-audit --desc` reports no known vulnerabilities over the whole environment - so the old pin was masking nothing else.

Classifying `duplicate` because the work was completed under another ticket. Noting for the record that 1dfd is titled for landing dependabot PRs, so the click override was carried alongside that work rather than being 1dfd s stated purpose - the code on main is nonetheless correct and complete.

Follow-up 9fb3-ab66-2a81-4940 (smoke-test the inspect-ai eval path) STAYS OPEN - that gap predates this fix, is unaffected by which change landed it, and stands on its own merits.
